verdict.rationale: CIPO's online services (MyCIPO, trademark filing, databases, bulk data) could plausibly offer event-triggered rules or automations, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents user-defined rules, triggers, or automatic actions on events. Bulk data, search, and electronic correspondence are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
